title: THE HIVE IS STILL PAPER
note: All project hardware is an editorial illustration of a proposal, not built infrastructure.

lines.text: What if moving Cook Inlet power means moving the computer instead?
lines.t: What if moving Cook Inlet power means moving the computer instead?

lines.text: Deep Green proposes sixty-six compute hives near Nikiski.
lines.t: Deep Green proposes sixty-six compute hives near Nikiski.

lines.text: Around them, three hundred thirty to three hundred fifty marine hydrokinetic turbines.
lines.t: Around them, three hundred thirty to three hundred fifty marine hydrokinetic turbines.

lines.text: The turbines would power them directly while seawater provides passive cooling.
lines.t: The turbines would power them directly while seawater provides passive cooling.

lines.text: Clever. Put the primary load beside its proposed power source.
lines.t: Clever. Put the primary load beside its proposed power source.

lines.text: A three point five mile cable would carry power and fiber ashore.
lines.t: A three point five mile cable would carry power and fiber ashore.

lines.text: The notice estimates one hundred megawatts. Where would it go?
lines.t: The notice estimates one hundred megawatts. Where would it go?

lines.text: The data center would be the primary use.
lines.t: The data center would be the primary use.

lines.text: Only spare power could reach the Railbelt. Could, not will.
lines.t: Only spare power could reach the Railbelt. Could, not will.

lines.text: Now put that diagram on a test bench.
lines.t: Now put that diagram on a test bench.

lines.text: The filing names no customer or committed financing.
lines.t: The filing names no customer or committed financing.

lines.text: No completed proof covers output, cooling, economics, grid connection, or environmental effects.
lines.t: No completed proof covers output, cooling, economics, grid connection, or environmental effects.

lines.text: That doesn't make it bad. It makes the next step a study.
lines.t: That doesn't make it bad. It makes the next step a study.

lines.text: On September fourth, F E R C opened public comment on the application.
lines.t: On September fourth, F E R C opened public comment on the application.

lines.text: If issued, the permit gives study priority.
lines.t: If issued, the permit gives study priority.

lines.text: It wouldn't authorize construction or prove that one turbine works there.
lines.t: It wouldn't authorize construction or prove that one turbine works there.

lines.text: Comments and competing applications are due November second at one P M Alaska time. Brief comments need no prior registration.
lines.t: Comments and competing applications are due November second at one P M Alaska time. Brief comments need no prior registration.

lines.text: So stop the cable one inch short of victory.
lines.t: So stop the cable one inch short of victory.

lines.text: Bringing compute to Cook Inlet's energy is the clever part.
lines.t: Bringing compute to Cook Inlet's energy is the clever part.

lines.text: It becomes an Alaska win when studies prove engineering, grid, economics, and environmental effects. What would you require?
lines.t: It becomes an Alaska win when studies prove engineering, grid, economics, and environmental effects. What would you require?
